scope: Navigation and visibility snapshot; not clinical or legal certification

projects.title: Critical care physiology
projects.description: Worked ICU and CTICU cases connect physiology, investigations, clinical reasoning and reassessment.
projects.focus: General knowledge, guideline recommendations and case-specific choices are labelled separately.
projects.boundary: Wholly synthetic cases; no patient-care or clinical-validation claim.

projects.title: Breast reconstruction analgesia
projects.description: A narrative literature review with reference-identity records, search diagnostics and interpretation notes.
projects.focus: Study populations, outcome interpretation and the limits of comparisons across evidence.
projects.boundary: Narrative educational analysis; selected source checks do not establish a systematic review.

projects.title: Smart NOA simulation
projects.description: A Python rule-checking simulation with fictional profiles, reproducible traces and documented limits.
projects.focus: Implemented behavior, unit arithmetic and the distinction between software checks and clinical safety.
projects.boundary: In-memory simulation with no patient, monitor or pump interface; not clinically validated.

projects.title: Non-opioid and opioid-sparing anesthesia
projects.description: A selected-source educational overview with a correction record and paired case discussions.
projects.focus: Review scope, claim-to-source reasoning and correction of unsupported historical claims.
projects.boundary: Educational overview; historical review-method and efficacy claims were withdrawn.

projects.title: TKA perioperative analgesia
projects.description: A narrative evidence map with regional anesthesia, recovery and synthetic case material.
projects.focus: Evidence populations, recovery outcomes and the limits of screening, extraction and pooling claims.
projects.boundary: The retained filename says Scoping-Review; the current work is a selected-source narrative map.

projects.title: Breast perioperative learning
projects.description: Perioperative learning modules and paired synthetic cases with source and applicability notes.
projects.focus: Patient factors, anesthesia options and reassessment in an educational case format.
projects.boundary: The repository name retains Protocol; the revised material is educational discussion.
